gripOrHq.title: Disgruntled Ice Technician
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. After passing a piece of ice during this run, you may derez that ice and end your run if you broke all the subroutines of that ice.

gripOrHq.title: Cloak
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [3] from the bank on Cloak when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

gripOrHq.title: Social Engineering
gripOrHq.rulesText: Hide at least 2 from your pool in your hand; the Corp then guesses how many bits you hid. If the Corp guesses correctly, lose that many bits. Otherwise, choose a data fort and a piece of ice on that fort. Then make a run on that fort, during which you automatically pass that piece of ice.

gripOrHq.title: Invisibility
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Invisibility when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Sneak Preview
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Sneak Preview
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Finders Keepers
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Roll three dice. Gain that many bits.

scoreArea.title: Encryption Breakthrough
scoreArea.rulesText: All code gates have +1 strength. When you score Encryption Breakthrough, reveal as many code gates as you wish. Then, gain [1] for each revealed or rezzed code gate.

rig.title: Invisibility
rig.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Invisibility when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Vewy Vewy Quiet
rig.rulesText: Put [2] from the bank on Vewy Vewy Quiet when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Rent-I-Con
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

scoreArea.title: Genetics-Visionary Acquisition
scoreArea.rulesText: Difficulty of Research agendas is reduced by 1.

scoreArea.title: Political Coup
scoreArea.rulesText:
Put [12] from the bank on Political Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Political Coup, if it has any bits.

scoreArea.title: Polymer Breakthrough
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [1] at the start of each of your turns.

ice.title: D'Arc Knight
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Management Shake-Up
root.rulesText: Add three advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

root.title: Chicago Branch
root.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

ice.title: Haunting Inquisition
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Runner cannot make another run during his or her next six actions.
[Subroutine] End the run.
